title: A length prefix larger than the input is allocated before reading (out of memory under an address-space cap)

target.versions_affected: go-xdr as pinned by go-stellar-sdk v0.7.1 (executed)

severity_basis: The runtime aborts with out of memory only under an address-space cap (1 GiB); without the cap the allocation is never touched and the decode is refused. Fixed upstream; go-stellar-sdk v0.7.2 and later carry the fix.
caps_note: No CAP applies: an XDR encoding rule that holds in every protocol version (the corpus's xdr-strict group).

entries.expected: refuse the input before allocating its claimed length
entries.observed: Executed: under prlimit --as=1GiB, v0.7.1 allocates the claimed length before reading and the Go runtime aborts with 'out of memory'; v0.7.2 rejects with 'data exceeds max slice limit'. Without the cap, in a fresh process, v0.7.1 rejects (the allocation is never touched).

entries.expected: refuse the input before allocating its claimed length
entries.observed: Executed: under prlimit --as=1GiB, v0.7.1 allocates the claimed length before reading and the Go runtime aborts with 'out of memory'; v0.7.2 rejects with 'data exceeds max slice limit'. Without the cap, in a fresh process, v0.7.1 rejects (the allocation is never touched).

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all), L0, on go@v0.7.1 under the isolated memory sandbox (RLIMIT_AS 1 GiB).
evidence.post_fix: go@v0.7.2 and later refuse with "data exceeds max slice limit".
evidence.expected_basis: RFC 4506: a variable-length array whose length prefix exceeds the remaining input is malformed.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 2 of 2 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0026.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added.
